headline: Bharat Petroleum Q2 Profit Slumps 22.5% to ₹4,993 Crore on Fuel Price Freeze
summary: State-run Bharat Petroleum Corporation reported a 22.5% drop in second-quarter net profit to ₹4,993 crore, adversely impacted by domestic fuel price freezes that squeezed downstream marketing margins.
why: BPCL is one of India's top state-owned oil refiners and fuel retailers, heavily exposed to retail pricing policy and global crude feedstock price swings.

impacts.name: Bharat Petroleum Corp Ltd
impacts.why: Retail fuel price freezes suppress marketing margins when input crude costs remain elevated.
